description.text: Checking this will cause classic 3D system nodes to be created.

default.value:
depthgen = nuke.thisNode() 
parentCamera = 'parent.parent' 
if depthgen.input(1): 
  parentCamera = parentCamera + '.' + depthgen.input(1).name() 

group = nuke.createNode('Group','',False) 
group.setName('DisplaceCard') 
group.setInput(0, depthgen) 
group.begin() 

inp = nuke.createNode('Input','',False) 

expr = nuke.createNode('Expression','',False) 
expr.addKnob( nuke.Double_Knob('focal') ) 
expr.addKnob( nuke.Double_Knob('haperture') ) 
expr.addKnob( nuke.UV_Knob('win_translate') ) 
expr['temp_name0'].setValue('cx') 
expr['temp_expr0'].setValue('(1 - win_translate.u) * width/2') 
expr['temp_name1'].setValue('cy') 
expr['temp_expr1'].setValue('height/2 - win_translate.v * width/2') 
expr['temp_name2'].setValue('d') 
expr['temp_expr2'].setValue('sqrt((x-cx)*(x-cx)+(y-cy)*(y-cy))') 
expr['temp_name3'].setValue('fx') 
expr['temp_expr3'].setValue('focal * width / haperture') 
expr['channel0'].setValue('depth') 
expr['expr0'].setValue('-(1/z - 1) / cos(atan(d / fx))') 
expr['focal'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.focal' ) 
expr['haperture'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.haperture' ) 
expr['win_translate'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.win_translate' ) 

classic3D = depthgen['classic3D'].getValue() 
card = nuke.createNode('Card2' if classic3D else 'GeoCard','',False) 
card['rows'].setValue(300) 
card['columns'].setValue(300) 
card['translate'].setValue(-1,2) 
card['lens_in_focal'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.focal' ) 
card['lens_in_haperture'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.haperture' ) 
if not classic3D: card.setInput(1, expr) 

normals = nuke.createNode('Normals' if classic3D else 'GeoNormals','',False) 
normals['action'].setValue('lookat') 

displace = nuke.createNode('DisplaceGeo' if classic3D else 'GeoDisplace','',False) 
displace['channels'].setValue('depth') 
displace['source'].setValue('red') 
displace['scale'].setValue(1) 
displace.setInput(1, expr) 

transform = nuke.createNode('TransformGeo' if classic3D else 'GeoTransform','',False) 
transform['translate'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.translate' ) 
transform['rotate'].setExpression( parentCamera + '.rotate' ) 

out = nuke.createNode('Output','',False) 
group.end() 

cardLinkStr = group.name() + '.' + card.name() 
displaceLinkStr =  group.name() + '.' + displace.name() 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( 'rows/columns' ) 
k.setLink( cardLinkStr + '.rows' ) 
group.addKnob( k ) 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( '' ) 
k.setLink( cardLinkStr + '.columns' ) 
k.clearFlag(nuke.STARTLINE) 
group.addKnob( k ) 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( 'scale' ) 
k.setLink( displaceLinkStr + '.scale' ) 
group.addKnob( k ) 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( 'weight' ) 
k.setLink( displaceLinkStr + '.weight' ) 
group.addKnob( k ) 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( 'offset' ) 
k.setLink( displaceLinkStr + '.offset' ) 
group.addKnob( k ) 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( 'filter_size' ) 
k.setLink( displaceLinkStr + '.filter_size' ) 
group.addKnob( k ) 
k = nuke.Link_Knob( 'filter' ) 
k.setLink( displaceLinkStr + '.filter' ) 
group.addKnob( k )

description.text: Set the maximum z depth.

The offset between the current frame and frames either side used to calculate depth.           Pixels are matched between the frames and triangulated to create 3D points with depth.           Increasing the separation gives a larger camera baseline and more accurate depth.           However, a high separation reduces the quality of pixel matching giving incorrect 3D points.           Use the 'Analyze Sequence' and 'Analyze Frame' buttons to calculate the best separation.           The input Camera must be defined for all frames within the frame range.

Use the mask input to exclude a masked region from the depth calculation.           This can be used to prevent distortions at moving foreground regions.           Depth can only be calculated where the real world 3D position does not change.           Try using a smaller 'Frame Separation' to capture moving objects           or set the ignore mask to exclude the moving region.           Regions should be marked as 1 with surrounding pixels as 0.
Mark regions where the depth calculation is ambiguous.
Set the minimum z depth.
Set the noise level for the input image.           Try increasing this to smooth depth in flat image regions.
Adjust this to vary the resolution of the surface normals.           Reduce the detail to smooth out the normals pass.

Use 'Depth' to output 1/z where z is the distance along the camera Z axis.           This matches the depth output of the ScanlineRender node.           Use 'Distance' to output the distance along the ray from the camera center           to the 3D surface point.
Sharpness defines how distinct object boundaries should be.           Increase this to separate objects and reduce to smooth depth.
Adjust this to vary the smoothness of the depth.
The strength in matching pixels between frames.           Increase this to force the matches, for example where fine details are missed,           or reduce to smooth depth.
Adjust this to vary the resolution of the depth field.

description.plain_text: DepthGenerator Generates depth given a camera input. The depth can be optionally output as a position and normals pass for use with PositionToPoints or Relight nodes. Set 'Frame Separation' to control the frames used to calculate depth. Frames should overlap well to match images but have a sufficient camera baseline to triangulate depth. Use 'Analyze Sequence' or 'Analyze Frame' to automatically set the frame separation. You can use the 'Calculated Accuracy' to select frames where the depth accuracy is highest.
description.text:
DepthGenerator

Generates depth given a camera input. The depth can be optionally output as a position and normals pass for use with PositionToPoints or Relight nodes. Set 'Frame Separation' to control the frames used to calculate depth. Frames should overlap well to match images but have a sufficient camera baseline to triangulate depth. Use 'Analyze Sequence' or 'Analyze Frame' to automatically set the frame separation. You can use the 'Calculated Accuracy' to select frames where the depth accuracy is highest.
